            rcases mem_iUnion.mp hx with ⟨hk, hxk⟩
            by_cases hkn : k = N
            · right
              simpa [hkn] using hxk
            · left
              have hk' : k < N := by omega
              exact mem_iUnion.mpr
                ⟨k, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hk', hxk⟩⟩
        rw [← heq]
        exact hunion

log.message: All goals closed.

import Aesop

set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem finite_ordered_path_connected_union {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (A : ℕ → Set X) :
    (∀ n, n < N → IsPathConnected (A n)) →
    (∀ n, n < N → n ≠ 0 → (A n ∩ ⋃ k < n, A k).Nonempty) →
    IsPathConnected (⋃ k < N, A k) := by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
      simp at hN
  | succ N ih =>
      intro hconn hinter
      by_cases hzero : N = 0
      · subst N
        simpa using hconn 0 (by simp)
      ·
        have hNpos : 0 < N := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
  
        have hprev : IsPathConnected (⋃ k < N, A k) :=
          ih hNpos
            (fun n hn => hconn n (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hn))
            (fun n hn hn0 =>
              hinter n (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hn) hn0)
  
        have hlast : IsPathConnected (A N) :=
          hconn N (Nat.lt_succ_self N)
  
        have hmeet : (A N ∩ ⋃ k < N, A k).Nonempty :=
          hinter N (Nat.lt_succ_self N) hzero
  
        rcases hmeet with ⟨x, hxA, hxprev⟩
  
        have hu : IsPathConnected ((⋃ k < N, A k) ∪ A N) :=
          hprev.union hlast ⟨x, hxprev, hxA⟩
  
        rw [show (⋃ k < N + 1, A k) = (⋃ k < N, A k) ∪ A N by
          ext y
          simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_setOf_eq, mem_union]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨k, hk, hy⟩
            by_cases hkN : k < N
            · exact Or.inl ⟨k, hkN, hy⟩
            · have hkEq : k = N := by omega
              exact Or.inr (hkEq ▸ hy)
          · rintro (⟨k, hk, hy⟩ | hy)
            · exact ⟨k, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hk, hy⟩
            · exact ⟨N, Nat.lt_succ_self N, hy⟩]
  
        exact hu
